title: ㅋㅋ 갑옷
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop R&B track with a mid-tempo groove. Clean electric guitar plays a syncopated four-bar loop using jazz-influenced seventh chords. A sub-heavy synth bass follows the kick drum pattern with short, staccato notes. The drum kit features a crisp snare on the backbeat and a tight, closed hi-hat playing sixteenth-note patterns. Male vocals alternate between a smooth tenor chest voice and airy falsetto during melodic leaps. Subtle vocal doubling and harmony stacks appear on key phrases. A digital reverb with a short decay is applied to the vocals and guitar. Key of E Major, 95 BPM, 4/4 time signature.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[clean electric guitar loop, syncopated rhythm]
(Mmm-mmm)

[Verse 1]
[male tenor vocals]
[sub-bass and kick drum enter]
너의 밤은 어때 혼자 누워
폰 화면 불빛이 천장을 물들여
난 단톡방에 링크 하나 던져놔
웃긴 영상이야 반응 오겠지
[hi-hats enter]
1분이 지나 3분째
읽음 표시만 쌓여가 반응 없어
괜찮아 원래 일 바쁜 거겠지
혼자서 웃어봐 기타 보네

[Pre-Chorus]
[falsetto]

알림음만 울려 그게 제일 무서워

[Chorus]
[vocal harmonies enter]
큭큭 웃어치는 게 내 무기야
웃는 건지 우는 건지 나도 몰라
